name: DLF Limited

profile.summary: DLF Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the business of colonization and real estate development in India. The company is involved in the real estate development activities, including identification and acquisition of land, planning, execution, construction, and marketing of projects. The company also develops and sells residential housing projects, including under-construction projects. In addition, it operates and maintains commercial office spaces, as well as retail properties, such as malls, shopping complexes, recreational spaces, and hotels and clubs.
